title: 1 Pa. Code § 3.12. Citation of Bulletin .
text:
§ 3.12. Citation of Bulletin .
Sections 506 and 507 of 45 Pa.C.S. (relating to judicial notice; and form of citation) provides that without prejudice to another mode of citation the Bulletin may be cited by volume and page number. The approved short form of citation to the Bulletin is ‘‘Pa.B.’’ Thus ‘‘3 Pa.B. 801’’ refers to material beginning on page 801 of Volume 3 of the Bulletin.
